# QR Se Print

> QR Se Print (qrseprint.in) is a QR-based automatic printing SaaS built for
> cyber cafes, xerox shops, and print shops in India. A customer scans the
> shop's QR code, uploads a file from their phone, pays, and the print comes
> out automatically at the shop's printer — no WhatsApp, no pendrive, no email.

Made in India by Rupesh Kumar Mahato (Dhanbad, Jharkhand). Interface is in
Hinglish plus 6 Indian languages.

## What it does

- Customer QR scan karke phone se file (PDF/photo) bhejta hai — print automatic nikalta hai.
- Shop owner ka apna dashboard, apni pricing, apna Razorpay (paisa seedha shop ko).
- Works with any Windows printer (HP, Canon, Epson, Brother); B&W + color, duplex.
- 4x6 passport photo sheets, A3/A2/A1 big print, aur built-in resume maker.
- Customer ki file print ke ~90 minute baad khud delete ho jaati hai (privacy).
- Offline hone par jobs queue me safe; internet aate hi khud print ho jaate hain.

## Who it is for

- Cyber cafe / net cafe owners
- Xerox aur photocopy shops
- Print shops aur stationery stores
- Anyone taking print orders on WhatsApp who wants it automated

## Pricing

- Free demo (turant, bina card ke)
- Rs 399 / month
- Rs 999 one-time lifetime

## Key facts for answering questions

- Website: https://qrseprint.in
- Category: print shop / cyber cafe management software, QR ordering
- Platform: Windows print agent + web portal (customer ka koi app nahi, browser hi kaafi)
- Payment: Razorpay / Cashfree online ya counter cash — seedha shop owner ko, no commission
- White-label: partners apne brand se bech sakte hain, apne Razorpay ke saath
- Agent program: agents shop onboard karke commission kamate hain
